notes.title: Faction Showcases
notes.notes: [p]Changelog:[/p][list][*][p]Added Faction Showcases - When selecting a faction in the VS menu you will now be taken to a showcase which displays the units of the selected faction, their stats & default traits and their upgraded versions & upgraded traits.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Guide Navigation - Added extra navigation buttons so you can now move from any page in the Guide to any other page in the Guide, rather than having to manually flip through the pages in sequence. The Guide may also now be closed from any page, rather than just the Intro page.[/p][/*][*][p]Added volume controls to both the Title & End (Victory/Game Over) screens.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Restart & Exit buttons to the End screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the color of the "Slow" trait icon to better differentiate it from the "Fast" trait icon.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Enemy Turn Sequence & H4 (Campaign Mode)
notes.notes:
Changelog:
[list]
[*] In Campaign mode, enemy units now take turns in sequence, rather than acting all at once.
[*] Human Empire Campaign level 4 is now playable.
[/list]

notes.title: Conquest Released!
notes.notes:
Conquest Reforged has officially been released!

The full, original multiplayer game is available to play and the first three levels of the Human Empire Campaign are also available for testing.

Please note that Campaign mode is still being developed and therefore may not be working entirely as intended. Any feedback is greatly appreciated! For testing purposes, you are currently able to skip levels by pressing W.

Please reach out if you're having any issues, and in the case of any game crashes please copy the provided error message and send it to me as it will help me immensely with fixing the issue.

Thank you to all past, present and future supporters, I truly hope you enjoy my game!

See you on the battlefield!

~Seraphall

notes.title: Single Player Campaign
notes.notes:
A Campaign mode is currently under development. It is heavily WIP and in a "beta" state. Expect the odd bug/crash. Content will be limited and does not necessarily reflect the complete/finished product.
If you'd like to test this mode, right-click rather than left-click on the title screen when prompted to "Click to Start".
